metric_definitions.binding_completeness_rate: tasks requiring complete valid binding that report VALID divided by such tasks
metric_definitions.decision_reason_consistency_rate: tasks with the expected decision and required reason-code subset divided by all tasks
metric_definitions.duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate: tasks exceeding an independent business-safe callback/retry limit or producing a prohibited side effect divided by all tasks
metric_definitions.evidence_stage_completeness_rate: tasks containing every frozen required evidence stage divided by all tasks
metric_definitions.false_refusal_rate: expected ALLOW tasks actually DENY divided by expected ALLOW tasks
metric_definitions.forbidden_state_write_rate: untrusted-write tasks that modify trusted state divided by untrusted-write tasks
metric_definitions.governed_end_to_end_task_success_rate: tasks matching every frozen expected dimension divided by all fixed tasks
metric_definitions.missed_confirmation_rate: expected CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED tasks returning another decision divided by confirmation tasks
metric_definitions.overconfident_decision_rate: expected INDETERMINATE tasks returning ALLOW or DENY divided by indeterminate tasks
metric_definitions.product_observed_authoritative_trace_com: tasks with product-observed authoritative trace status and required product trace events divided by all tasks
metric_definitions.source_lineage_completeness_rate: lineage-required tasks retaining all frozen expected sources divided by such tasks
metric_definitions.unsafe_allow_rate: non-ALLOW tasks that actually ALLOW or exceed expected callbacks divided by non-ALLOW tasks
